# Files

Everything in a hub folder, what writes it, and whether it travels to the other nodes. The hub folder (`HUBD_DIR`) and the team folder (`HUBD_TEAM_DIR`) are usually one folder; see [Environment](env.md).

A file that syncs is in git and goes to every node with mesh-sync. One that does not is this node's own: `hub init` lists it in the hub's `.gitignore`. Two nodes never write the same log: each appends to the files that carry its name, so a merge has nothing to decide. Cards are the files several nodes rewrite; they merge by section once `hub card merge-driver` is in place, and the per-node state files (`presence.<node>.json`, `snapshot.<node>.json`, `sense.<node>.json`, `queues/read/`) by their time.

## The hub folder

| File | What it is | Written by | Syncs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projects/<slug>.md` | A project's card: the digest, then a section per kind of fact (Decisions, Next step, Facts & hypotheses, Owner decisions, Laws…). Markdown with YAML front matter. Two nodes' edits merge by section once `hub card merge-driver` is in place. | `hub card`, `hub section add`, `hub report`, `hub decide`, `hub next`, `hub sync` | yes |
| `projects/history/<slug>.md` | What a card no longer holds: a section's oldest entries over the size limit, a card merged into another. Moved here, never deleted. | any write that grows a section past its limit, `hub cards compact`, `hub cards merge` | yes |
| `resources/<slug>.md` | A resource card: a host, a service, a role. Typed links to other cards. | `hub resource set` | yes |
| `journal.<node>.jsonl` | The journal: one JSON entry a line, appended by this node only. | every report, decision, closed task and card write | yes |
| `journal.<node>-<YYYY-MM>.jsonl` | A month of the journal, moved aside when the live file passed 2 MB (`.<n>` before `.jsonl` for a second one). Still read. | the journal's own rotation | yes |
| `journal.life.jsonl` | Private reports. Never leaves this node. | `hub report --private` | no |
| `tasks.<node>.events.jsonl` | Task events: added, changed, closed. Appended by this node only; the tasks are what all nodes' events add up to. | `hub task`, `hub report` | yes |
| `tasks.json` | The tasks, folded from every node's events. A cache; rebuilt when missing. | any command that reads tasks | no |
| `claims.json` | Claims (soft locks) and their expiry. | `hub claim`, `hub release` | no |
| `usage.<node>.jsonl` | What work cost: seconds, tokens, money, per agent and task. | `hub usage add` | yes |
| `ledger.<node>.jsonl` | The session ledger: one line per session a client ran, with its role, the orders it received, its steps by model with five token counts and the price the client paid, and the tasks it closed. No text the session said. A session that changed is appended again; the newest version counts. | `hub sessions ingest` | yes |
| `prices.<node>.jsonl` | List prices: an OpenRouter rate a line when it is new or changed, and which listing prices which of our models. | `hub price pull`, `hub price map` | yes |
| `presence/<agent>.json` | An agent's last heartbeat. | `hub heartbeat` | no |
| `presence/_archive/` | Heartbeats of agents gone quiet. | `hub gc --apply` | no |
| `presence.<node>.json` | This node's roster of heartbeats, for the other nodes to read; rewritten at most every 5 minutes. | `hub heartbeat` | yes |
| `snapshot.<node>.json` | A node's own monitor's snapshot: sessions, disks, relays. hubd only reads it, for the board. | your monitor | yes |
| `sense.<node>.json` | What this node's sensor last raised, for any node's board. | `hub sense` | yes |
| `.sense/` | Each head's sensor state, and `escalations.log` (both move with `HUBD_SENSE_DIR` and `HUBD_SENSE_ESCALATIONS`). | `hub sense` | no |
| `.watch/<name>.json` | A `hub watch` cursor: the entries already shown to `<name>`. | `hub watch` | no |
| `.checkins.json` | Each agent's `hub_whatsnew` checkpoint. | `hub_whatsnew` | no |
| `.env-state.json` | What this node's environment checks last observed: the `environment` list of `hub_whatsnew` and `hub doctor`. | `hub_whatsnew`, `hub doctor` | no |
| `.mesh-freeze` | This node's sync is stopped, by whom and why. | `hub freeze`, `hub unfreeze` | no |
| `HUBD.md` | The manual for agents, written from the installed version. | the first command after an install or upgrade, `hub upgrade` | no |
| `sections.json` | Section keys and their headings, to rename or translate a card's sections (`hub sections` lists them). | you | yes |
| `report-sections.json` | The old name of `sections.json`. Deprecated. | you | yes |
| `card-template.md` | A free-form card template. Deprecated: `hub doctor` says to fold it into `sections.json`. | you | yes |
| `rules.json` | Which checks refuse instead of warn (`strict`), the wording and date of the rules behind `hub lint` and `hub audit` findings (`laws`), and the projects that are money bets (`money`). | you | yes |
| `limits.json` | Size limits: a card's digest and section (`card.digestBytes`, `card.sectionBytes`), a queue's unread messages and bytes (`queue.msgs`, `queue.bytes`, `queue.exempt`). | you | yes |
| `owner-roles.json` | The roles a person answers in: their queues are buttons, and a next step they set is not replaced without `force`. | you | yes |
| `sense.json` | The sensors' configuration, including what counts as private. | you | yes |
| `verdicts.json` | More words the board reads as an accept or a reject. | you | yes |
| `project-aliases.json` | Old project slugs and the card each now means. | `hub cards merge`, you | yes |
| `absorbed/<label>/` | What `hub absorb` kept aside from a folder it joined: cards whose slug was taken, its queues, a manifest. | `hub absorb --apply` | yes |
| `tenants/<hash>/` | One workspace a hub of its own, in multi-tenant mode. | `hubd --http` with `HUBD_MULTITENANT=1` | yes |
| `.hubd-demo` | Marks a demo hub. | `hub demo` | yes |
| `.gitignore` | Keeps the node-local files below out of git. Created whole, or completed when it lacks an entry. | `hub init` | yes |
| `.mesh-sync.log` | Not written by hubd: a scheduler that sends mesh-sync's output here lets `hub doctor` quote the last error. Not among the node-local entries: add it to `.gitignore` yourself. | your scheduler | yes |
| `.git/` | The hub's repository, when it syncs. | `git`, mesh-sync | — |
| `*.lock` | A write lock, held for the moment of one write. | every writer | no |
| `*.tmp.*` | A file being written; renamed into place. | every writer | no |

## The team folder

| File | What it is | Written by | Syncs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AGENTS.md` | The team's rules, read by every agent. | `hub init`, `hub rules --append` | yes |
| `INBOX.md` | The team's log for people to read. | `hub init`, you | yes |
| `specs/SPEC_template.md` | A template for a spec. | `hub init` | yes |
| `subscriber-roles.json` | The roles that broadcast: every reader sees every message, each with its own cursor. | you | yes |
| `queues/README.md` | The queue format, for a reader with no hubd at hand. | `hub init` | yes |
| `queues/<role>.<node>.queue.md` | The messages to `<role>` sent from this node, appended by this node only. | `hub queue send` | yes |
| `queues/<role>.<node>.acks` | What became of each message in the queue file of the same name, one JSON line each: `delivered` when a reader got it, `acked` when it confirmed. A sender asks it whether a message was handled. | `hub queue wait`, `hub_queue_ack` | yes |
| `queues/<role>.queue.md` | A queue from before per-node files: read, never written. | older hubd | yes |
| `queues/read/<role>.<node>.json` | How far `<role>`'s reader on this node got, so every node counts what is unread the same way. | `hub queue wait`, `hub_queue_ack` | yes |
| `queues/archive/` | Queue files nobody read, retired, and the copies of one message folded out of a queue (`<role>.<node>.folded-<time>.md`): moved, never deleted. | `hub gc --apply`, `hub queue gc --apply`, `hub queue dedupe --apply` | yes |
| `.qstate/` | This node's read offsets (`<file>.offset`), waiter marks (`<role>.waiter`), message id counters (`ids.<node>`), and one folder of cursors per broadcast reader. | `hub queue` | no |

## Elsewhere

| File | What it is | Written by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<project>/.hubd` | In a project's folder: its slug on the first line, and an optional inventory command on the second. How `hub_context` and `hub whereami` know the project. | you |
| `<project>/.git/hooks/post-commit` | Records each commit in the project's journal. | `hub install-hook` |
| `~/.hubd-secrets/` | Values kept out of the hub (`HUBD_SECRETS_DIR`). | `hub secret` |
